title: Medical Image Atlas: retinal, mammography and prostate pathology
description:
A multi-domain atlas of what is seen in medical images, what can be measured and on which images: anatomy, lesions, measurement items with open measurement code, grading criteria and diseases for retinal imaging, mammography and prostate pathology. Figures use only CC BY 4.0 / CC0 1.0 public images with attribution.

Code: MIT. Atlas tables and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Images: licence of each source (see LICENSE-docs.md). Browsable version: https://aixlab-gnu.github.io/medical-image-atlas/. Not a diagnostic tool.
